1. (Currently Amended) An ultrasonic surgical instrument assembly comprising: a handpiece; a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece; a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; and a light source attached to said handpiece and configured to direct at least visible electromagnetic radiation along the probe towards a surgical site distal of the probe.

10. (Currently Amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a distal end of said handpiece and is oriented to provide illumination along said probe to a surgical site distal of said probe.

12. (Currently Amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a coil disposable about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, the accessory further comprising at least one fastener for removably attaching said coil about the power cable.

19. (Currently Amended) A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; attaching said light source to said handpiece so that light from said light source is directable along the length of said probe; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operating of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operating of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said source.
